metadata.title: Ransomware Resilience (Secure‑Resilience Aligned)

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for responding to ransomware events without introducing unsafe recovery or unauthorized resumption.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Ransomware containment, eradication, recovery tooling, and resilience decision gating.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Solution pattern implementing ransomware response actions subject to Secure‑Resilience eligibility.

props.name: secure-resilience-dependency
props.remarks: Ransomware recovery and resume actions are governed by Secure‑Resilience state classification and resume eligibility.

metadata.remarks: Ransomware Resilience provides capability to contain, eradicate, and recover from ransomware attacks. Restoration and resumption are explicitly prohibited unless Secure‑Resilience determines state is reversible, no recall is active, safe‑halt is not required, and resume eligibility is granted.

components.title: Ransomware Containment
components.description: Containment of ransomware impact to prevent further spread or execution.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Continuity arrangements prevent further harm during incident containment.

components.title: Clean State Verification
components.description: Verification that a putative clean state is uncompromised and valid.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Recovery testing validates integrity of restored components.

components.title: Ransomware Recovery Eligibility Gate
components.description: Permits restoration only when Secure‑Resilience determines recovery will not introduce new risk.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Recovery actions are gated by safety and eligibility context.

components.title: Restore Suppression Under Ransomware Conditions
components.description: Prevents restore or resume when recall, irreversible state, or safety risk is present.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Availability of backups does not imply restore permission during ransomware events.

components.title: Ransomware Resilience Non‑Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Explicitly defines what ransomware remediation does not grant or imply.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Removal of ransomware does not imply permission to restore or resume.

tactics.name: Impact
tactics.description: Adversary actions intended to disrupt availability or destroy data.

categories.name: Isolate
categories.description: Separating compromised systems to prevent propagation.

categories.name: Restore
categories.description: Restoring systems only when explicitly permitted.

categories.name: Recover
categories.description: Recovering service functionality under resilience constraints.
